title: Planning asks an open choice a goal leaves for each file it names, not for one of a pair
goal: precheck warns of a committed item whose goal names two or more ledgers or files that the same open choice applies to while a gate answers it for only one of them, so the choice for each is asked before the start (SP-7nv2ffr2: ST-l2p6dpkr had gate g1 for _fetch_state.csv columns and the worker stopped mid-work on the same choice for _anchors.csv) (SP-7nv2ffr2 close).
